name: AutoGLM (Zhipu AI)
desc: Tsinghua spinout. Foundation agent series for autonomous smartphone/PC GUI control. Persistent task memory retains shopping history, app usage patterns, multi-step task state across sessions. AutoGLM-Thinking claimed first agent capable of concurrent thinking and acting.
deployment: Both

name: Backboard
desc: Stateful AI API combining persistent memory, RAG, web search and routing across many LLMs behind one interface, with SDKs for Python and npm; benchmarks its memory on LoCoMo and LongMemEval.
deployment: Managed cloud API; vendor also advertises private-cloud, on-prem and on-device deployment
pricing: Free $0; Education $5; Developer $20; Scale $400 (billing period not stated on page)

name: ByteRover
desc: Agent-memory product. LLM-curated hierarchical context.
deployment: Local-first CLI (curl installer or npm byterover-cli; background daemon since v2.0.0); optional cloud for team sync, multi-machine access and backup

name: Cellon (Memory.inc)
desc: Korean startup. Connects scattered internal/external data across multiple chats and services to improve AI answer quality at retrieval. 18-year-old CEO Jang Jun-ha; pitch is that answer quality depends on what the model remembers, not which model.
deployment: searched not found

name: Cipher (byterover) (now ByteRover CLI)
desc: Renamed ByteRover CLI (brv); repo campfirein/byterover-cli archived read-only 2026-09-27, license changed to Elastic License 2.0. Opensource memory layer focused on programming agents — works with Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Roo Code via MCP. Maintains a coding-context memory across sessions and across IDEs.
deployment: Local CLI (works offline with own/local LLM provider); optional ByteRover cloud for team sync and backup

name: Cognee
desc: "Extract–Cognify–Load" pipeline that turns raw input into a typed, queryable knowledge graph for agent recall.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; Cognee Cloud managed; Enterprise BYOC)
pricing: Free $0 (1 workspace, 1M tokens); Standard $1 per 1M tokens + $5/workspace/mo; Enterprise BYOC custom

name: Hindsight (Vectorize)
desc: Standalone memory service from Vectorize. Open source. Biomimetic four-network design (World, Bank, Observation, Opinion). Ships an MCP memory server.
deployment: Both — managed Hindsight Cloud; Enterprise single-tenant (Vectorize cloud, customer AWS/GCP/Azure, or on-prem); self-host via Docker, Helm or pip (Postgres + pg
pricing: OSS self-host free (MIT); Hindsight Cloud pay-as-you-go credits ($5 free credit on GitHub sign-up); Enterprise single-tenant custom

name: Honcho (Plastic Labs)
desc: Memory library/service for stateful agents that reasons over stored messages to build 'peer' representations (theory-of-mind style user models) queryable via a dialectic API; used as Hermes Agent's and OpenClaw's user-modelling backend. Traction: ~7.7k stars; integrated into Hermes Agent and OpenClaw; public evals at evals.honcho.dev
deployment: searched not found

name: Hyperspell
desc: YC F25 'company brain': connects 50+ sources (Slack, Gmail, Notion, Drive...) into a permission-aware context graph served to agents via API/SDK, returning structured results or LLM-ready summaries; learns from queries over time.
deployment: Cloud API + SDK (no self-hosted option found)

name: Interloom
desc: Back-office operations platform where agents and domain experts triage and resolve cases; each resolved case feeds a context graph, and a 'MemoryRank' component reuses prior successful cases to route new work.
deployment: Managed multi-tenant SaaS (AWS); private single-tenant VPC (Azure); private VPC with bring-your-own-model
pricing: No seat fees (unlimited users); usage-based per agent interaction — prepaid volume packages or pay-as-you-go

name: Jamba (AI21 Labs)
desc: Israeli production model. Interleaves Mamba SSM layers with Transformer attention (1:7 ratio) + MoE blocks every 2 layers. SSM layers maintain fixed-size recurrent hidden state — compressed long-context memory bypassing growing KV cache.
deployment: Both (AI21 Studio cloud; Azure/AWS Bedrock/GCP Vertex AI; private VPC; on-premises)
pricing: Free trial ($10 credit, no CC required); pay-as-you-go per token; enterprise custom pricing with VPC/on-prem
license: Apache-2.0 (Jamba2); earlier Jamba 1.5–1.7 under Jamba Open Model License

name: Krutrim Kruti (Ola)
desc: Shut down: Kruti was taken offline in Apr 2026 (pulled from app stores and the Ola platform, no official explanation). Was Ola Krutrim's agentic multimodal assistant (beta Jun 2025; booking, food ordering, bill pay; MCP/A2A for enterprises).
deployment: Cloud-hosted on Indian servers (Krutrim Cloud; sovereign India-first)
pricing: n/a — service offline since Apr 2026 (was free beta)

name: Letta / MemGPT
desc: Originated as MemGPT (UC Berkeley), where the model pages its own memory between context, recall and archival tiers. The product now centres on Letta Code, a stateful agent harness whose agents rewrite their own memory, skills and prompts over time.
deployment: Both
pricing: Free $0 (3 agents); Pro $20/mo; Developer pay-as-you-go ($0.10/active agent/mo); Teams; Enterprise custom

name: M3-Agent (ByteDance)
desc: ByteDance Seed + Zhejiang Univ + SJTU. Multimodal agent with long-term memory as entity-centric graph built from live video + audio streams. Parallel memorisation + control processes. Ships M3-Bench evaluation dataset.
deployment: Self-hosted (research code; API config + memory graph files)
pricing: not applicable — academic research code (no commercial pricing)

name: Mem0
desc: Universal memory layer for AI agents. Three concurrent stores (vector + graph + KV); LLM-extracted facts; concurrent retrieval via ThreadPoolExecutor.
deployment: Both

name: MemMachine
desc: Multi-layered open-source memory system for AI agents.
deployment: Both — self-hosted, or managed MemMachine Platform
pricing: OSS free (Apache-2.0); managed MemMachine Platform with free account (paid tiers not listed in README)

name: MemWal (Walrus)
desc: Walrus is a Sui-blockchain decentralised storage protocol; MemWal is its AI-facing SDK that stores encrypted agent memory on-chain — portable, verifiable, shareable across agent systems with no single-vendor lock-in. Targets production agents needing auditability.
deployment: Decentralised blockchain storage (Sui blockchain via Walrus protocol; SDK in beta)
pricing: Comparable to centralized models (per Mysten Labs; $WAL token-based usage)

name: Memanto (Moorcheh)
desc: A 'memory agent' that manages other agents' memories, deciding what to keep, what conflicts, what expires and who needs to know; runs locally (Docker/Ollama) or as a free cloud. Traction: ~2.2k stars; self-reported 89.8% LongMemEval / 87.1% LoCoMo
deployment: searched not found

name: Memary
desc: Open-source long-term memory framework for autonomous agents.
deployment: Self-hosted (OSS; no cloud service found)

name: Memobase
desc: User-profile-based long-term memory. Per-user profile + event timeline. API + Python/Node/Go SDKs + MCP server. Profile-centric rather than fact-centric.
deployment: Both (self-hosted Docker + Memobase Cloud managed)
pricing: Free + paid (Memobase Cloud free tier for testing; pay-as-you-go for production)

name: MemoraX AI
desc: Shenzhen. Argues attaching external vector stores is architecturally flawed; trains memory as an intrinsic capability via Agentic RL. Plans B2B enterprise KM and C2C personalisation in 12 months. Founded by Tianjin University AI professor.
deployment: searched not found

name: Memori
desc: Structured, persistent memory layer for AI agents. Open source.
deployment: Both (Memori Cloud zero-config + self-hosted OSS)
pricing: Free + paid (Memori Cloud; tiered plans for builders / growing / production teams)

name: Memori (GibsonAI) (now Memori Labs)
desc: Now Memori by Memori Labs (repo moved to MemoriLabs/Memori; adds managed Memori Cloud and BYODB). SQL-native memory engine for AI agents — single library, opt-in conscious/auto modes, structured Pydantic outputs. Aims to be 'one line of code' to add memory to any LLM workflow.
deployment: Both — OSS SDK self-hosted; Memori Cloud managed; enterprise single-tenant/VPC/on-prem
pricing: OSS free (Apache-2.0); Memori Cloud API key with free developer tier (rate-limited); enterprise by contact

name: Memoria (MatrixOrigin)
desc: Memory layer from MatrixOrigin. Strong-retrieval / clear-reader-separation design.
deployment: Both — Memoria Cloud (thememoria.ai, remote mode) or self-hosted Docker Compose with MatrixOne (embedded mode); Kubernetes documented

name: Memoripy
desc: Memory layer for AI assistants — semantic short-term and long-term memory with concept-graph linking and decay/reinforcement.
deployment: searched not found

name: Memory Store (now MemStore)
desc: Renamed MemStore (memory.store now redirects to mem.store); YC Spring 2026. Shared memory layer delivered as an MCP server: a team's AI agents record decisions/progress across sessions and recall from teammates' stores with sources attached; daily email rollup.
deployment: Managed-only (hosted; no self-host option documented)
pricing: $150 per team member/mo after 7-day trial (single plan)

name: MemoryBear
desc: Open-source memory system modelled on human cognition, with perception, extraction, association and forgetting stages; also offered as a hosted product. Traction: ~6.5k stars; #18 in TeleAI Awesome-Agent-Memory
deployment: searched not found

name: Memvid
desc: Single-file memory layer (one .mv2 file). No DB, no server. Append-only sequence of immutable Smart Frames with timestamps + checksums. Native Rust core (rewritten from Python).
deployment: Self-hosted only (single .mv2 file; no cloud service)
pricing: OSS (Apache-2.0); free — no commercial pricing found

name: NAVER HyperCLOVA X THINK
desc: Reasoning-focused successor to HyperCLOVA X. Pre-trained on ~6T high-quality Korean + English tokens. 128K context via rotary position embeddings + grouped-query attention. Sovereign reasoning LLM for Korean enterprises and government.
deployment: Managed-only

name: NVIDIA Inference Context Memory Storage Platform (now NVIDIA CMX Context Memory Storage Platform)
desc: Renamed NVIDIA CMX Context Memory Storage Platform (2026). A BlueField-4 (STX) powered "AI-native context tier" that extends GPU memory with a shared pod-level KV-cache tier for long-context, multi-turn agentic inference, with Dynamo routing and DOCA Memos SDK managing cache across compute and storage nodes. Announced CES Jan 2026; offered via storage partners (Dell, HPE, IBM, NetApp, VAST, WEKA,
deployment: On-prem rack-scale (NVIDIA Rubin cluster + partner storage); managed via DOCA

name: Neo4j Agent Memory (Neo4j Labs)
desc: Neo4j Labs' graph-native agent memory library (Python and TypeScript) that stores conversations, builds knowledge/context graphs and records agent reasoning traces to learn from. Traction: Official vendor-lab project; packages published on PyPI and npm
deployment: searched not found

name: NeoCognition
desc: Builds agents that learn from experience by constructing a "world model" of the micro-environment they operate in. Specialise over time through Agentic RL loop rather than relying on static prompt context. Targets the ~50% task-completion failure rate in current agents.
deployment: searched not found

name: Nyne
desc: Identity graph of ~2.2B people and 380M businesses exposed through people-data APIs (identity resolution, enrichment, search) for AI agents; now also brokers licensed data and domain experts for AI labs.
deployment: Cloud API (agents deployed across web to build people graph; no self-hosted option found)
pricing: Not public — API access by request

name: O-Mem
desc: Omni memory system for personalised, long-horizon, self-evolving agents. From OPPO PersonalAI.
deployment: Self-hosted (research code; no cloud service)
pricing: not applicable — academic research code (no commercial pricing)

name: OMEGA
desc: Local context/memory engine for coding agents: stores decisions, docs and agent history on-machine (SQLite + local ONNX embeddings) and serves a ranked slice per task over MCP. Open-core Apache-2.0 core with paid Pro tier.
deployment: Local-only (local ONNX embeddings + SQLite; macOS + Linux; Windows via WSL)
pricing: Core free (Apache-2.0); Pro $19/mo (multi-agent coordination, LLM routing, knowledge base, encrypted sync)

name: OpenMemory (now LongMemory)
desc: Renamed LongMemory (repo CaviraOSS/LongMemory; packages longmemory / longmemory-sdk, with openmemory-js@2 / openmemory-py@2 as forwarding bridges). Open-source cognitive memory engine for LLMs and agents.
deployment: Self-hosted (local + Docker; no cloud service found)
pricing: OSS (Apache-2.0 self-hosted); self-hosted cost ~$5-8/mo for 100k memories vs $60-120 for SaaS

name: OpenViking (ByteDance Volcengine)
desc: Open-source 'context database' from ByteDance's Volcengine that unifies agent memory, RAG knowledge and skills behind a virtual filesystem (viking:// URIs) with tiered loading and self-evolving context. Traction: ~39k GitHub stars; #6 on GitHub agent-memory topic; listed #3 in TeleAI Awesome-Agent-Memory products
deployment: searched not found

name: Pieces for Developers (LTM)
desc: Long-term memory engine for developers — captures everything the user does (browser, IDE, terminal) on-device, exposes via MCP for any IDE/agent.
deployment: Local + hybrid cloud sync

name: Redis Agent Memory Server
desc: Redis's official working + long-term memory server for agents (REST and MCP), with automatic extraction, semantic search and topic/entity tagging; also used to give Snowflake Cortex Agents persistent memory. Traction: Major infrastructure vendor's official memory server; Redis-Snowflake integration blog
deployment: searched not found

name: SuperLocalMemory
desc: Cloud-free agent memory using information-geometric retrieval (Fisher-Rao distance + BM25 + entity graph + temporal fusion via 4-channel RRF) instead of LLM calls for scoring and lifecycle. Mode A is the only system to cross 70% LoCoMo with zero API dependency.
deployment: Local-only (no Docker; no graph DB; no API keys; CPU-only; Mode A zero-LLM)
pricing: free / open source (AGPL-3.0); commercial licence terms unpriced

name: Supermemory
desc: Memory engine with API, app, browser extension, and MCP server. Extracts facts, tracks updates, resolves contradictions, auto-forgets expired info. Plugins for Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes.
deployment: Both

name: TencentDB Agent Memory
desc: Tencent's team-level memory hub that turns conversations, docs and code into four reusable memory assets: chat memory, skills, an LLM-wiki and a code graph. Traction: ~30k GitHub stars; big-tech vendor
deployment: searched not found

name: Trace
desc: YC S25 + $3M seed (Feb 2026). Workflow orchestration mapping corporate environments as a structured context graph so agents always have institutional knowledge for tasks. CTO frames differentiator as "context engineering."
deployment: Cloud (SaaS integrating Slack/Jira/Notion; no self-hosted option found)
pricing: not public — beta with waitlist / contact

name: VEKTOR Memory
desc: Node.js/TypeScript-native memory layer. SQLite + local Transformers.js embeddings (~80MB model via WebAssembly). AUDN loop (Add/Update/Delete/None) resolves contradictions before write rather than at retrieval — read-after-write consistency.
deployment: Local-only (Node.js; Transformers.js via WebAssembly; SQLite; no cloud infrastructure)

name: Zep & Graphiti
desc: Bi-temporal knowledge graph (event time + ingestion time). Strong on chronological reasoning and contradiction tracking. Graphiti is the open-source core.
deployment: Both — Zep Cloud managed; Graphiti OSS self-hosted (Neo4j/FalkorDB)
pricing: Free 10k credits/mo; Flex $125/mo ($104 annual) 50k credits; Flex Plus $375/mo ($312 annual) 200k credits; Enterprise custom

name: gbrain (Garry Tan)
desc: Open-source agent 'brain' storing explicit sourced facts with corrections and withdrawals, shared across agents; built as the memory for OpenClaw/Hermes agents. Traction: ~31k GitHub stars; author is YC CEO; listed #6 in TeleAI Awesome-Agent-Memory
deployment: searched not found

name: memU (NevaMind)
desc: Lightweight agent memory system that builds a shared, file-like 'memory wiki' across sessions, agents and devices and can extract reusable skills from agent history; also offered as a hosted service (memu.pro). Traction: ~14k stars; #9 on GitHub agent-memory topic
deployment: searched not found

name: AGENTS.md
desc: Open Markdown 'README for agents' at repo root; nested files in subprojects take precedence (closest wins). Holds build/test commands, conventions and PR rules. Stewarded by the Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation); supported by Codex, Jules, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Devin/Windsurf and others.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: Aider CONVENTIONS.md / .aider.conf.yml
desc: CONVENTIONS.md (any name, loaded via --read or read: in config); .aider.conf.yml (home / git-root / cwd, last wins); .aiderignore (gitignore-syntax).
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: Basic Memory
desc: Local-first MCP memory where each memory is a Markdown note with observations and wikilink relations that form a traversable knowledge graph, indexed with SQLite (optional Postgres vectors), plus an optional hosted cloud. Traction: ~3.6k stars; widely used MCP memory server with a paid cloud tier
deployment: searched not found

name: CLAUDE.md
desc: CLAUDE.md files (managed, user, project, local scopes) concatenated into context at session start, with @imports and path-scoped .claude/rules/; complemented by Claude-written auto memory (MEMORY.md index). Project-root file re-injected after /compact.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: Cline .clinerules
desc: Markdown rule files in a workspace .clinerules/ (or .cline/rules/) directory plus global rules in ~/Documents/Cline/Rules; workspace wins on conflict. Per-rule toggles, conditional rules via YAML 'paths' globs, and AGENTS.md / .cursorrules / .windsurfrules are also read.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
